description: This PHP source file defines a final class UriNormalizer within the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace. The class provides methods for normalizing and comparing URIs based on various configurable normalization flags. It includes constants for different normalization strategies such as capitalizing percent-encodings, decoding unreserved characters, and removing default components. The main method is static 'normalize', which applies selected normalizations to UriInterface objects. It also offers a method for URI comparison considering normalization.

classes.name: UriNormalizer
classes.description: Provides static methods to normalize and compare URIs with configurable normalization flags.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns a normalized UriInterface object after applying specified normalizations based on flags.

methods.name: isEquivalent
methods.description: Checks if two URIs are equivalent after applying normalization and optional normalization flags.
